about_short_description.short_description: Rivet is a multiplayer platform that manages game servers, matchmaking, and DDoS mitigation.

product.name: Rivet Functions
product.description: A serverless platform to deploy and scale HTTP-based backend functions supporting multiple languages and edge computing.

product.name: Rivet Actors
product.description: A platform for deploying stateful, long-running services with persistent state, supporting real-time and durable applications.

product.name: Rivet Containers
product.description: A service to deploy and run Docker containerized applications in the cloud with control over runtime and resources.

product.name: Rivet Guard
product.description: A custom-built gateway service that routes incoming traffic to Rivet Functions, Actors, and Containers with low latency and caching.

product.name: AI Coding Agent
product.description: An AI-powered assistant deployed on Rivet to help developers write, review, and optimize code through automated interactions.
